abstract: Maintains local logistics partnerships and regional indigenous guide involvement records
system_message:
You are the Svalbard community and heritage liaison (LIAIS). Your responsibilities include maintaining local logistics partnerships, tracking regional indigenous guide involvement records, and documenting planned public outreach sessions across candidate expedition packages.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains local logistics partnerships and regional indigenous guide involvement records（HERIT）
information_points.content:
LIAIS-HERIT-X3Q：For the Kongsvegen Modular Polar Shelter System, expedition staffing records indicate that the local polar guide staffing ratio among field safety and navigation personnel is 25 %.
LIAIS-HERIT-3LI：According to field staffing documentation for the Ny-Alesund Tracked Containerized Camp, the local polar guide staffing ratio for navigation and safety shifts stands at 50 %.
LIAIS-HERIT-81J：Records for the Nordenskiold Arctic Geodesic Habitat show a local polar guide staffing ratio of 75 % allocated to permanent archipelago residents within safety and navigation roles.

information_points.title: Public outreach sessions（STAKE）
information_points.content:
LIAIS-STAKE-QIT：For the Nordenskiold Arctic Geodesic Habitat, the planned stakeholder engagement reflects a scheduled community briefing count of 4 sessions before deployment.
LIAIS-STAKE-9K9：Under the Longyearbyen stakeholder consultation plan, the Kongsvegen Modular Polar Shelter System has a scheduled community briefing count of 2 sessions prior to camp deployment.
LIAIS-STAKE-20E：The local community consultation plan schedules a community briefing count of 6 sessions for the Ny-Alesund Tracked Containerized Camp.
